Description: Hojicha is following matcha's path: lattes are appearing on UK café menus, TikTok conversation has roughly doubled since 2024, and powders are only just reaching Ocado and wider retail. Opportunity in premium powders, RTD lattes, teabags and baking or ice cream ingredients, with a lower-caffeine evening angle and a natural premium price point.

Premium fro-yo is back in London, with Go Greek and Yo-Chi drawing multi-hour queues and Time Out-style and Hot Dinners coverage across multiple openings, all amplified on TikTok as a 'wellness' treat. Opportunity in premium frozen yoghurt tubs and bars, high-protein Greek-style formats, and toppings (açaí, pistachio spread, cookie dough) at a premium price tier.

Shokupan and milk buns are crossing from TikTok into home kitchens, with Waitrose.com searches for Japanese milk buns up 617% in a month and creators using them for smash burgers and sandwiches. Opportunity in fresh and frozen shokupan loaves and buns, sando-style kits and own-label bakery lines, as there is little premium supply on UK shelves yet.

Trend: Turkish / Eastern Mediterranean (pide / mangal / Turkish breakfast)
Description: London restaurant media is reporting a Turkish dining moment: new pide and mangal openings in Soho, Turkish breakfast spots and fine-dining chefs gaining attention. Opportunity in premium pide and flatbreads, Turkish breakfast spreads and cheeses, baklava and sesame or pistachio sweets, and meze or grill-at-home meal kits that go beyond standard hummus.

Trend: Korean snacking beyond gochujang (tteokbokki / spicy noodles)
Description: Korean demand is moving past sauces into snacks and noodles, with Asian supermarkets reporting demand tripling for items like Samyang noodles and tteokbokki, plus London's first Korean food festival and Waitrose-style Korean-inspired launches. Opportunity in premium instant noodles, tteokbokki kits, Korean snack and ice cream lines, and fusion products that pair 'swicy' flavours with gut-health positioning.
